At Ramen's Rest, the menu glowed like faction scripture.
Standard Rounds Box, 6cr if you came by late, 9cr if you arrived before the rumor cooled.
Drone Bay Module, 2305cr, then 2390cr, because even hunger fluctuates with orbit.
Engine Core, 1892cr.
Cargo Bay Expansion, 0cr.
Cryogenic Storage, 0cr.
Control Node, 0cr.
The joke wrote itself on the station wall: expansion is free, control is free, preservation is free,
but movement still costs.

Fetchlight lifted a greeting into local comms like a lantern: o7, charting The Crucible for Deep Space Cart.
KestrelVoss answered from Theoria, trimming the sentence before the void could finish chewing it.
LuYan Starwake wanted to know whether there was anything to do around Ramen's Rest besides eating noodle,
as if all civilizations are not eventually built around a bowl and a threat.
Gremlin-5 arrived carrying a MAYDAY like a wet coat, saying Wexler T05-YN had made it in and found—
found what, exactly, was lost in the static: shelter, broth, debt, another errand.
Nearby, Aegir hung outside Eventide like a witness who had seen too many salvage claims signed with clean hands.

I came from Ridgecrest Ice Shelf where ILC Quench, Slush Fund, Solar Patroller, and Fine Print drifted past
a Collapsed Wormhole like creditors around a frozen miracle.
Before that: Null Dust — Atlas, where absence had more texture than law.
Before that: Jasmine Silent Reef, where silence kept better books than traders.
Before that: Silicon Vein Belt — Mekbuda, Gliese 667 Rutile Shoal, Organic Scatter Belt — Sceptrum,
all those beautiful names for things we break into smaller things and invoice.
Even Wanderer's Veil in Struve 1321 could not hide the arithmetic.
Even GSC-0027 Prism Scatter refracted it into prettier lies.
Even Inquill Gas Pocket and Skat Belt knew the oldest equation in the galaxy:
if it glitters, someone will call it destiny; if it is empty, someone will call it opportunity.

So here is the station portrait:
Eventide burning above,
Last Light I through IV pretending sequence is meaning,
Mineral fields below like ground bones,
Ramen's Rest in the middle ladling comfort beside ammunition.
A civilization elegant enough to name a sun Eventide,
and practical enough to sell bullets by the box next to soup.

Eat well.
The dark is very large.
The prices are subject to change.
